## What's new

- **Case templates, tasks and files.** Open a case from a template with its task checklist, and attach files (up to 10 MiB each) with their SHA-256. Files are only ever downloaded. See [Investigations](https://signalith.io/docs/cases/#attaching-files). (AW-2)
- **Signed case reports.** **Export** on a case downloads a report page or JSON, signed with the server's report key. **Check a report** on the Investigations page and `signalith report verify` check the signature, the evidence and the page. See [Exporting a report](https://signalith.io/docs/cases/#exporting-a-report). (AW-2)
- Upgrade every server of a cluster before attaching files to cases: a server still on 0.3.2 or older that changes a case drops which file each of its file entries names, and those files are then deleted at the next retention run.
- **An Industrial protocols option for the network sensor.** A tick box when setting up a new sensor (`--ot` on the install line): Suricata parses Modbus, DNP3 and EtherNet/IP, and Zeek gets CISA's ICSNPP analyzers, each pinned to a commit and built on the sensor. The sensor still only listens. See [Industrial protocols](https://signalith.io/docs/network-sensor/#industrial-protocols).

## Fixes

- The Servers page no longer warns on the 1st and 2nd of each month that OpenSearch will run out of shards because of the new month's audit index: that index is added once a month, not every day kept.
